shots.say: Look! A giant footprint in the sand! Who made it?
And there are more! One, two, three mystery footprints!
I'm Milo the bluebird. Let's play Guess With Milo!
The Animated Zoo!
Look closely at each footprint, and say your guess. Ready? Let's follow the footprints!
Here is a footprint. It is big, and round. Whose foot made it?
Is it the elephant? Or is it the lion?
It is the elephant!
Here is the fun fact. An elephant walks on its tiptoes!
Under its toes is a big, soft cushion. Like a squishy pillow!
Why does an elephant need a cushion?
The cushion soaks up the bump, when a big, heavy elephant steps down. Squish!
Look at those big, round feet. Step, step!
Elephants have toenails, too! Let's count them. One, two, three, four, five!
Some elephants have four nails on a front foot. Some have five!
Elephants may even feel tiny rumbles in the ground, with their feet!
Put your hand flat on the floor. What can you feel?
Say it with me. An elephant walks on its tiptoes!
Can you walk on your tiptoes, like an elephant? Tip, tip, tiptoe!
Quick check! What is under an elephant's toes? A soft cushion, or a wheel?
A soft cushion! Squish, squish. Great job!
Here is another footprint. Look! It has two halves, side by side. Whose foot made it?
Is it the zebra? Or is it the giraffe?
It is the giraffe!
Here is the fun fact. A giraffe has two hooves on each foot!
Count the hooves with me. One, two!
And its feet are big! As big as a dinner plate.
How does a giraffe walk, on such long legs?
It moves the two legs on one side together. Then the two legs on the other side!
shots.tag: legs: one side, then the other

shots.say: Look! This side, this side. That side, that side!
That way, its front legs and its back legs do not bump!
And a baby giraffe can stand up and walk, about an hour after it is born!
Wobble, wobble, up it goes!
Stand up tall, like a giraffe. Stretch!
Say it with me. A giraffe has two hooves on each foot!
Can you walk like a giraffe? This side, this side. That side, that side!
Quick check! How many hooves are on each giraffe foot? Two, or ten?
Two! Two hooves on every foot. Super thinking!
Here is the last footprint. It is one smooth, round print. Whose foot made it?
Is it the elephant? Or is it the zebra?
It is the zebra!
Here is the fun fact. A zebra walks on just one toe, on each foot!
Let's count the toes on one zebra foot. One! Just one!
Hold up one finger, for one zebra toe. One!
So what is that hard part, at the bottom?
It is a hoof! The hoof wraps around the toe, and keeps it safe.
Look at those strong hooves. Clip, clop, clip, clop!
A hoof keeps on growing, all the time. A little like your fingernails!
Four legs, four hooves! Count with me. One, two, three, four!
And every zebra has its very own stripes. No two zebras are the same!
Say it with me. A zebra walks on one toe!
Can you trot like a zebra? Clip, clop, clip, clop!
Quick check! How many toes are on each zebra foot? One, or five?
One! One toe, inside one hoof. You remembered!
Three footprints, and three friends! Now it is quiz time!
Whose footprint has two halves? The giraffe's, or the elephant's?
The giraffe! Two hooves on each foot.
Whose footprint is one smooth hoof? The elephant's, or the zebra's?
The zebra! One toe, one hoof.
Whose footprint is big and round? The lion's, or the elephant's?
The elephant! On its soft, squishy tiptoes.
Look at our footprint trail! You guessed them all!
Tiptoe like an elephant. Walk this side, that side, like a giraffe. And trot like a zebra!
Next time on Guess With Milo: whose ears are these? Bye-bye, friends!
The Animated Zoo!
